purpose: put the approved build into production by an authorized, repeatable path with health checks and stop conditions
entry_criteria: Change approval exists for this release id and window
Artifact digest matches the approved release
Rollback plan is ready and monitoring is watched
inputs: approved release id and artifact digest
procedure: Verify the artifact digest equals the approved one and that the window is open.
Deploy with the pipeline using the approved strategy (rolling, canary or blue-green).
Watch error rate, latency and saturation against the stop thresholds during rollout.
Proceed in steps; stop and roll back if a threshold is crossed.
Record start and end times, versions and who deployed.
Hand over to the smoke test (stage 138).
acceptance_criteria: Deployed digest equals the approved digest
Thresholds stayed within limits or rollback occurred

validation.expect: image digest equals the approved digest

failure_modes.response: Roll back and redeploy the approved artifact
Stop and roll back per plan

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A canary receives 5 percent of traffic for ten minutes with stable error rate and latency, then proceeds to 100 percent; the digest check matches the approved release.
